About Me

Who I Am

I'm Gagan Ashok Shanku, a passionate B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at MIT Vishwaprayag University (VPU), Solapur. I have a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, software development, and innovative problem-solving.

I'm enthusiastic about creating impactful tech solutions — from AI-based applications and e-waste management systems to citizen-focused digital platforms. I love combining creativity with technology to build practical and user-friendly projects.

Actively working on SDG-focused technology solutions, I also have experience in presentations, technical reports, business growth ideation, and practical technology implementation.
